title: Nice long wide slots, but only toasts one side. T-fal customer service confirmed toaster not functioning properly.
text:
Nice long wide slots, but only toasts one side. T-fal customer service confirmed toaster not functioning properly.. Original Review 4/29/2015: This toaster has huge slots. Very easily fits 4 slices of American supermarket sliced bread. Would be great for bagels. I want the long slots for toasting longer, thicker pieces of decent bread. As other reviewers have stated, the cord does come out from the right side of the unit near the front. That placement is a bit odd. See third photo.

In all likelihood, you will have to flip your toast around to get the machine to toast both sides of your bread. The heating elements only glow red on the sides of the toaster. The heating elements on the inside panel don't come on, regardless of heat setting. See first two photos - taken at highest heat setting of 8.

I have not encountered any issues with beeping or smoking. The lift feature just lifts the bread a fraction of an inch. I still use wooden toaster tongs to grab my bread. If the heating elements on the center panel actually came on, I would probably give this 5 stars ---- so far...

Updated Review 4/30/2015: I was concerned about the one sided toasting and called T-fal customer service. The customer service representative informed me that the heating coils on the inside panel should come on unless the toaster is set to bagel. The toaster I received (and probably some of the units received by other reviewers) is defective. I have changed my rating to one star.

In addition, it seems that I am not the first person to receive this particular toaster. The toaster was only cushioned by foam on one end and there was space in the box for cushioning on the other end. There was an extra plastic bag in the box and there was no manual or warranty information inside the box. Looks like Amazon shipped out a toaster that had been returned by another customer.

product_metadata.title: T-fal TL6802 4-Slice Digital Toaster with Bagel Function, Black
features: 2 European slice toaster with extra high-lift lever for easy removal of small sized breads and English muffins; Extra-wide, self-adjusting slots are ideal for any bread thickness and ensure even toasting
8 browning settings from light to dark; Bagel, Defrost, Reheat and Stop functions
Sharp blue digital LCD displays shows browning level and toasting time countdown
Pull-out crumb-tray for easy cleaning; Cord storage on base of unit
description: Enjoy 2 long slices of bread browned to your preference thanks to the T-fal TL6802002 4-Slice Digital Toaster. Its 8 different browning settings enable a precise and adjustable browning control. The T-fal Digital Toaster features a Bagel function that toasts the outside and gently warms the inside - the way a bagel should be toasted. For more convenience, the T-fal TL6802002 Digital Toaster features an extra high-lift lever to remove easily your toasts and a removable crumb-tray for an easy cleaning.
